metrics.fcpMs: First Contentful Paint from the browser paint timeline.
metrics.lcpMs: Largest Contentful Paint entry observed before scripted scrolling.
metrics.inpMs: Not measured; one lab interaction cannot be reported as field INP.
metrics.maxEventTimingMs: Maximum Event Timing duration for the scripted table-search interaction; a lab proxy, not INP.
metrics.cls: Cumulative layout shift before scripted scrolling, excluding shifts with recent input.
metrics.labTbtMs: Long-task blocking time after FCP through the initial settled snapshot; a lab metric, not field data.
metrics.scriptDurationMs: Chromium CDP ScriptDuration; cumulative renderer script execution duration.
metrics.activationLatencyMs: Custom metric from the loading fallback appearing to the deferred table DOM marker.
metrics.hydrationDuration: Not measured; no hydration-duration claim is made.
